data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name Gobi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Govind' meaning 'God'. The name Gobi signifies a person connected to the divine and holds a strong spiritual connection with the mountains and nature. The name Gobi carries the meaning “Hill, Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gobi usually hope their child will grow to embody hill, mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
